The '''Nicolo Peak''' was a mountain on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It bordered the [[Val'Arnos Jungle]] and was close to another lone mountain peak, the [[Borundi Peak]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nicolo Peak is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
